summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancing the REST specification with proposals for an `unregister` endpoint and the addition of the X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header. Additionally, updates on the integration of Iceberg with Spark and the introduction of finer-grained read restrictions were highlighted in community sync notes.
highlights: Proposal for unregister table endpoint in REST spec
Updates on Iceberg Spark Community Sync
Proposal for finer grained read restrictions in loadTable
